state_machine.name: MANUAL
state_machine.outputs: MotorForward = ForwardButton AND NOT ReverseButton; MotorReverse = ReverseButton AND NOT ForwardButton; CompletionLight = false; phase forced to WAIT_A

transitions.action: Return to automatic mode; wait for A; no automatic motion on entry
Clear automatic state and completion; stop automatic motion

transitions.when: Mode == true AND SensorA AND ButtonA
transitions.action: Start forward movement from A to B; one transition per scan

state_machine.name: MOVE_AB
state_machine.outputs: MotorForward=true; MotorReverse=false; CompletionLight=false unless arrival transition applies in same scan

transitions.action: Clear automatic state and completion; stop automatic motion
Destination arrival stops forward output in same scan
Clear automatic state and completion; stop automatic motion

transitions.when: Mode == true AND SensorB AND ButtonB
transitions.action: Start forward movement from B to C; one transition per scan

state_machine.name: MOVE_BC
state_machine.outputs: MotorForward=true; MotorReverse=false; CompletionLight=false unless arrival transition applies in same scan

transitions.action: Clear automatic state and completion; stop automatic motion
Destination arrival stops forward output in same scan
Clear automatic state and completion; stop automatic motion

transitions.when: Mode == true AND SensorC AND ButtonC

state_machine.name: DONE
state_machine.outputs: MotorForward=false; MotorReverse=false; CompletionLight=true while SensorC remains true

transitions.action: Clear automatic state and completion; stop automatic motion
Product removed; clear CompletionLight in same scan and wait for A

timer_plan.reset_conditions: None. No IEC timers are required by the specification; all transitions are level- and phase-qualified. If timers are added later, call their FBs unconditionally outside CASE/IF and reset them on Mode=FALSE, manual entry, or instance reset.

priorities: Safety first: MotorForward and MotorReverse must never be true simultaneously.
Manual conflict resolution: if ForwardButton and ReverseButton are both true, both motor direction outputs are false.
Mode reset priority: entering manual mode clears automatic phase to WAIT_A and forces CompletionLight off.
Destination arrival priority: SensorB in MOVE_AB or SensorC in MOVE_BC stops forward motion in the same scan before any next processing step.
One automatic phase transition per scan; arrival stop has priority over station-complete start.
Automatic mode allows forward motion only; reverse output is false in automatic mode.
CompletionLight is on only in DONE while SensorC is true; removal of SensorC clears the light and returns to WAIT_A.
Station buttons are accepted only when their corresponding sensor and wait phase are active.
Outputs are assigned once in the final scan stage from the post-transition state, with a final mutual-exclusion interlock.

scan_execution_order.name: edge sampling
scan_execution_order.description: Sample all inputs I[k] at invocation. Compute R_TRIG flags for Mode, ForwardButton, ReverseButton, ButtonA, ButtonB, and ButtonC for diagnostics and mode-entry detection. Automatic station acceptance uses level-qualified SensorX AND ButtonX per assumptions; edge flags do not create multiple transitions.

scan_execution_order.name: safety/reset priority and state transitions
scan_execution_order.description: Apply Mode=FALSE first: enter MANUAL, force phase=WAIT_A, clear automatic state and CompletionLight. Then apply automatic transitions in priority order: destination arrival stop (MOVE_AB AND SensorB -> WAIT_B; MOVE_BC AND SensorC -> WAIT_C), station complete start (WAIT_A AND SensorA AND ButtonA -> MOVE_AB; WAIT_B AND SensorB AND ButtonB -> MOVE_BC; WAIT_C AND SensorC AND ButtonC -> DONE), and removal (DONE AND NOT SensorC -> WAIT_A). At most one automatic phase transition per scan. Manual-to-auto entry goes to WAIT_A only.

scan_execution_order.name: unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
scan_execution_order.description: No timer FBs are required. If timers are added for future debounce or delay, instantiate and call them unconditionally at top level outside CASE/IF; reset them on instance reset, Mode=FALSE, or manual entry.

scan_execution_order.name: unified output assignments
scan_execution_order.description: Assign MotorForward, MotorReverse, and CompletionLight exactly once from the post-transition state/phase. MANUAL: MotorForward=(ForwardButton AND NOT ReverseButton); MotorReverse=(ReverseButton AND NOT ForwardButton); CompletionLight=false. AUTO WAIT_A/WAIT_B/WAIT_C: all outputs false. AUTO MOVE_AB/MOVE_BC: MotorForward=true unless arrival transition moved to WAIT_B/WAIT_C in this scan; MotorReverse=false; CompletionLight=false. DONE: MotorForward=false; MotorReverse=false; CompletionLight=true while SensorC. Final interlock: if MotorForward AND MotorReverse then both are forced false.
